content.text: The register path doesn't pass a provider, so the default in `UsersService.create` (google) applies.

candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is not given. AuthService.register doesn't set a provider, so every email-registered user is stored with provider 'google'. At login, AuthService.validateLogin sees provider !== email and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'. The default should be AuthProvidersEnum.email.
register calls usersService.create without provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default to `createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email`. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
